answers.core:
Users would expect stability of their node data without needing an add-on.
It should "just work", and you should be able to quickly set up a scene in the editor for rapid prototyping/testing.
We shouldn't have to worry about our scene setup being reset for inexplicable reasons and losing hours (or more) of work.

Also, this requires a lot of complex code to do manually.
The fact that nodes can lose their data because they use tool scripts is dangerous and can be a huge setback.
This had me pulling my hair out until I implemented my workaround (which is far from perfect.)
answers.workaround: This would benefit anyone that uses tool nodes to lay out a scene.

title: Prevent data loss on reloaded instanced scenes (which use tool scripts)
